generation.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Production game asset for QuRa, one PLATINUM treasure chest, CLOSED. Edit the referenced blue bronze chest. Keep the same charming polished 3D cartoon rendering, rounded wooden chest silhouette, three-quarter camera, small diamond clasp, and footprint. Change only the tier materials: pale icy blue lacquered wood, lustrous cool platinum/silver metal bands and clasp with subtle cyan-white gemstone. It must read as platinum silver, no copper or gold bands, with restrained premium detail. Warm directional highlights consistent with a friendly farm fantasy game, crisp clean edges. Single chest centered, fully visible, identical viewpoint and proportions to reference. Occupy about 65% of a square canvas, leave transparent margin. Remove any existing dark background, red fringe or edge residue. True transparent background, no text, numbers, watermark, extra objects, platform, border or cast shadow outside the object.

fixture_notes: Item rarities, prices, levels and displayed bonuses are examples, not new authoritative metadata for the 35 items. Current equipment art manifest has no economy fields; developer must bind the server catalog.
Displayed 300 GE / 99 ₽ is the current base handful package example from app/services/ge_shop_catalog.py (blob 0c15028d6ae3e24d6d787c0753128f0a3b0356af); server configuration remains authoritative.
All three Poultry heroes are available in this demonstration account. Boss unlock instructions describe game rules, not an unlocked/locked gate for this fixture.
Rankings, run totals, balances, player names and share battle facts are demonstration data, not live account data.
The prototype verification success button demonstrates a positive server response. It is not a client-side verification bypass.

Screen fixtures show representative states, not a live inventory/ledger/payment simulation. Sale and award idempotency, eligibility, verified status, native back and public share URL require production implementation in the linked issues.
